requested_display: Original T90A design: cannon fixed upward; hull shows its actual rotation relative to the turret, independently of player camera direction.

available_queries.local.connector_rotation(name,axis): Joint rotation of turret against hull, independent of free viewing angle
available_queries.local.has_connector(name): Connected/detached gate for the relevant turret/hull connector

missing_input: A future player-view-up pose would still need angles against the current view. The restored cannon-up pose uses the existing joint-relative queries and needs no mod changes.
user_decision: 姿态表先按照原本的设计吧；应该是炮管朝上
current_presentation: Cannon-up T90A-style live pose. Synchronized body quaternions and actual connector frames supply joint-relative XYZ degrees. Explicit hull z-index 1, cannon z-index 2; signed angle readout.
preview: Explicitly simulated readings, with cannon fixed up and hull rotated left 35 degrees (turret right 35 degrees relative to hull).
modification_scope: 34 collision proxy origins/sizes, HUD/language/release data, plus the existing HudPartSnapshot query sampler class; all other mod JAR entries are byte-identical.
binding_math: Hull CSS angle = atan2(sin(Y), cos(Y) * cos(X)); X/Y are degrees from the active host connector. Both connector ends share the same joint tuple; full-circle Euler recovery avoids Y-only quadrant folding.
